documents.text: Harland Bradley Howe Harland Bradley Howe (February 19, 1873 – April 22, 1946) was a United States federal judge. Howe was born in St. Johnsbury, Vermont on February 19, 1873, the son of Worcester C. Howe and Rosaline (Bradley) Howe. He was educated in Caledonia County, and graduated from Lyndon Institute. Originally trained as a harness maker, he contracted polio which left him unable to perform such demanding physical labor.
